name: minimal organic homunculus

phase_0.boundary_condition: the bioreactor vessel and its nutrient medium

VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated stem cell aggregate before any structure, function, or boundary emerges.

TANCH.justification: The hermetic seal and physical boundary that contains the entire homunculus system and its environment.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism translating external environmental stimuli into internal electrochemical gradients.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism and descent from neural computation down to physical effector response.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of sensory percepts into coherent, actionable motor plans.

IMSCRIB.justification: The system's self-recognition of its own embodied state, closing the self-reference loop.

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of the unified sensory signal into parallel perceptual processing and motor planning pathways.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of perception and action into a single, coherent sensorimotor experience.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where sensory predictions perfectly match environmental reality.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of prediction failure, signaling a need for corrective motor action.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice of being simultaneously biological tissue and computational node, held without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, append-only recording of the experience into chromatin structure and synaptic weights.

phase_3.void_description: undifferentiated pluripotent state — no structure, no memory, no boundary, no self-model
phase_3.true_description: homeostatic match — prediction error is zero, system is in perfect equilibrium
phase_3.false_description: allostatic drift — prediction error accumulates, system requires corrective intervention
phase_3.both_description: the living paradox — the tissue is simultaneously the observer and the observed, both biological and computational

steps.domain_action: protoplasmic seed — genesis of the undifferentiated stem cell aggregate
sensory transduction — forward morphism translating environmental stimuli into electrochemical gradients
sensorimotor bifurcation — branching the unified signal into parallel perceptual and motor pathways
homeostatic equilibrium — T-arm anchor affirming successful sensory prediction
neural integration — sequential chaining of percepts into coherent motor plans
allostatic error — F-arm anchor signaling prediction failure and corrective need
motor actuation — reverse morphism descending from computation to physical effector response
embodied closure — reconstituting the unified sensorimotor signal from perception and action
proprioceptive self-model — the system recognizes its own embodied state, closing the self-reference loop
living simulation — entering B-state paradice, holding the paradox of biological tissue and computational node simultaneously
epigenetic fixation — permanent append-only recording of the experience into chromatin structure
bioreactor vessel — the terminal anchor and hermetic seal containing the entire homunculus

phase_5.compiler_frontend: morphogenetic gradients and gene regulatory networks
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: electrochemical action potentials and synaptic vesicle release
phase_5.memory_mechanism: synaptic weight plasticity and epigenetic chromatin remodeling
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: circadian clocks and homeostatic allostatic set-points
phase_5.alfs_store: the reference genome and the bioreactor's nutrient medium formulation

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: homeostatic baseline with resting membrane potentials
phase_6.post_cycle_state: homeostatic baseline with updated synaptic weights and epigenetic marks
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the system operates at the edge of criticality, dissipating energy exactly to maintain structural integrity and memory without runaway thermal decay
